title: Hayati Pro Max Summer Dream Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Summer Dream brings together a tropical trio of Pineapple, Mango, and Papaya for a fruity vape full of golden, sun-soaked flavour. The Pineapple adds a juicy tang, the Mango offers lush sweetness, and the Papaya brings a soft tropical depth—blended for a rich, exotic taste. Crafted with nicotine salts for quicker satisfaction and a smoother inhale, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using pod kits and starter devices. Its 50VG/50PG balance ensures consistent flavour clarity with discreet vapour production. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
